response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the additional adhesive layer is positioned between the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a honeycomb structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 283: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 284: The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 285: The tool of claim 284, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 286: The tool of claim 284, further comprising a plurality of cutting segments located on an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 287: The tool of claim 284, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

(Currently Amended) Claim 288: The tool of claim 284, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285, further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 285, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments.

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 293, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.
